# Group Policy template (03 §3.5, 04 §8.6): ShellDrive.admx, one ShellDrive.adml per culture, and the
# policy headers, all generated by tools/sd-admxgen from res/policy/policies.txt and l10n/policy/<lang>.po.
# The output does not depend on the configuration (Debug and Release write the same files), so it is
# created once under generated/policy/. sd_policy_gen is part of ALL.

set(_table "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/policies.txt")
set(_po_dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/l10n/policy")
set(_po "")
foreach(_lang IN ITEMS en es fr pt-BR it de)
  list(APPEND _po "${_po_dir}/${_lang}.po")
endforeach()

set(_cultures en-US es-ES fr-FR pt-BR it-IT de-DE)
set(_outputs "${SD_POLICY_DIR}/ShellDrive.admx" "${SD_POLICY_DIR}/sd_policy_ids.h" "${SD_POLICY_DIR}/sd_policy_table.h")
set(_dirs "")
foreach(_c IN LISTS _cultures)
  list(APPEND _outputs "${SD_POLICY_DIR}/${_c}/ShellDrive.adml")
  list(APPEND _dirs "${SD_POLICY_DIR}/${_c}")
endforeach()

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT ${_outputs}
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${SD_POLICY_DIR}" ${_dirs}
  COMMAND "$<TARGET_FILE:sd-admxgen>"
          --table "${_table}" --po-dir "${_po_dir}"
          --out-dir "${SD_POLICY_DIR}" --header-dir "${SD_POLICY_DIR}"
  DEPENDS sd-admxgen "${_table}" ${_po}
  COMMENT "sd-admxgen: ShellDrive.admx, ADML for six cultures, policy headers"
  VERBATIM)

add_custom_target(sd_policy_gen ALL DEPENDS ${_outputs})
set_target_properties(sd_policy_gen PROPERTIES FOLDER "policy")
